notes.title: Road Maintenance Simulator | Release Date
notes.notes:
On the 7th of April, the Road Maintenance Simulator will finally be released for the PC and consoles! 
Choose from a variety of vehicles and functional tools to master the numerous exciting missions.
Your daily tasks include, for example, applying road markings, trimming trees or asphalting country and state roads, as well as highways.  
Will you be able to successfully master the extensive daily routine in a road maintenance company?
